verdict.rationale: Extend offers deployable workflows, an asynchronous mode on every processing endpoint, and webhook subscriptions, so document pipelines can run in the background and notify on completion. Confidence-based auto-acceptance with routing to human review adds some autonomous decision-making. However, the evidence shows runs being started by API, SDK or CLI calls, not self-triggering automations. missing for 10: documented autonomous triggers (schedules, inbox/folder or event-based ingestion), detail on workflow automation steps, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Every processing endpoint in Extend (extract, classify, split, parse, and edit) supports both a synchronous and asynchronous mode.
A workflow has one editable draft and any number of immutable deployed versions.
